# sprint-review

> Open-source CLI, GitHub Action and MCP server (npm: @guuskeunen/sprint-review, MIT) that turns a sprint's git history into a sprint review presentation in business language. Every line on the slides is checked in code against the real commits; screenshots are diffed to show before and after. Output: one self-contained HTML deck with speaker notes and a presenter view, plus review.json (editable content), review.md, checks.md and optionally deck.pptx.

Use it when someone wants a sprint review deck, sprint demo slides, a stakeholder update or release slides from a git repository, every sprint, without writing them by hand.

Quick start (Node 20+, inside a git repository):

- `npx @guuskeunen/sprint-review --dry-run` shows the commits it would read; no model call.
- `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... npx @guuskeunen/sprint-review` writes the deck for the last sprint (default 14 days) to `sprint-reviews/<date>/`.
- `npx @guuskeunen/sprint-review --since 2026-11-03 --until 2026-11-16` or `--from v1.4.0 --to v1.5.0` for a specific range.
- `npx @guuskeunen/sprint-review edit sprint-reviews/<date>/review.json` opens a local editor beside the live deck.
- `npx @guuskeunen/sprint-review init` writes a commented `sprint-review.config.yml`.
- Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add guuskeunen/sprint-review` then `/plugin install sprint-review@sprint-review`.
- `npx @guuskeunen/sprint-review mcp` runs it as an MCP server (tools: generate_sprint_review, preview_sprint_commits, render_sprint_review, check_sprint_review_setup). Claude Code: `claude mcp add sprint-review -- npx -y @guuskeunen/sprint-review mcp`.
- GitHub Action: `uses: guuskeunen/sprint-review@v0` with `anthropic-api-key`, after `actions/checkout@v4` with `fetch-depth: 0`.

## Facts

- Models: Anthropic by default (claude-opus-5-5, falling back to claude-sonnet-5-5). Also `model.provider`: bedrock, azure, openai, openrouter, gemini, mistral, ollama, lmstudio (local: nothing leaves the network).
- Sends commit subjects, bodies, file names and (with GITHUB_TOKEN) pull request descriptions. Never source code.
- Checks in code: each point must cite real commit hashes or it is dropped; ci/build/test/docs/chore commits only go under the hood; word limits; ticket and PR numbers stripped; a team word list applied; a second model call reads only the slides and flags unclear lines, which are rewritten once and checked again. All logged in checks.md.
- Brand: `brand.color`, `brand.logo`, `brand.fonts`, or `brand.from` with a website (`https://...`) or a `.pptx` to take the color, fonts and logo from it. `brand.theme: light` (default) or `dark`.
- Cost: every run prints its estimated LLM cost and adds it to `sprint-reviews/costs.csv`; `--dry-run` estimates it first. `model.price` sets the price for providers without a built-in one.
- Languages: English and Dutch labels built in; any language for the text via `language`.
